title: Women of the Bible
subtitle: A 21-Day Bible Buddy Study
description: Twenty one women, twenty one days. From Eve in the garden to Martha and Mary in the house at Bethany, these are the women God used to carry His story - and they were not on the margins of it. Some are brave. Some are broken. Some did terrible things. Jezebel is here and so is Delilah, and none of them are cleaned up for you. Every day gives you the reading, what to watch for before you start, the woman's story told straight, questions that are hard to dodge, one concrete action, and a prayer.
